source.location: source packet for the article, section 1

problems.claim: Agent-driven repository, branch, PR and CI volume increases coordination pressure.
problems.requirement: one mutable branch has one active writer and every route converges without an active-writer conflict

mechanism.statement: the stacked-PR worker plus the Molecular index own branch and route convergence

oracle.statement: replay the route index against the tree and assert no two live routes claim one branch

denominators.denominator_definition: live routes named by the Molecular index at the subject commit

source.location: source packet for the article, section 2

problems.claim: Git packfile and local-filesystem semantics make naive remote or distributed storage difficult.
problems.not_applicable_rationale: this repository hosts no Git storage backend, so the problem has no mechanism here to implement or to refuse

source.location: source packet for the article, section 4

problems.claim: A push should not be acknowledged before durable authoritative persistence.
problems.requirement: no delivery receipt is emitted before the artifact it names exists on the tree

mechanism.statement: the zero-network delivery receipt gate reads the tree before admitting the receipt

oracle.statement: plant a receipt whose artifact is absent and require the gate to exit non-zero

denominators.denominator_definition: receipt shapes the gate enumerates, planted absent-artifact cases counted separately

source.location: source packet for the article, section 8

problems.claim: Primary-only compaction reduces per-replica CPU work by a stated factor.
problems.requirement: compaction work is performed once and distributed rather than repeated per replica

mechanism.statement: the shared object store is written once per worktree set and read by every worktree

oracle.statement: count object-store writes per worktree creation and compare against the worktree count

denominators.denominator_definition: worktree creations observed at the subject commit
